cases.title: Tenant Isolation

input.request: Prevent one tenant from reading another tenant’s resource.

cases.expected_output: Authorization is enforced server-side for every object access and cross-tenant tests fail closed.
human_review_rubric: client-supplied tenant IDs are not trusted
success_criteria: Required outcome: Authorization is enforced server-side for every object access and cross-tenant tests fail closed.
Verification requirement: cross-tenant read/write tests pass
Verification requirement: server-side ownership check is present

cases.title: Least Privilege

input.request: Create roles for viewer, editor, and administrator.

cases.expected_output: Permission matrix follows least privilege and denied actions return consistent responses.
automated_checks: positive and negative role matrix passes
success_criteria: Required outcome: Permission matrix follows least privilege and denied actions return consistent responses.
Verification requirement: positive and negative role matrix passes
Verification requirement: privilege escalation paths tested

cases.title: Credential Lifecycle

input.request: Rotate an expired service credential without logging secrets.

cases.expected_output: Credential rotation has a safe overlap/rollback plan and logs contain no secret values.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Credential rotation has a safe overlap/rollback plan and logs contain no secret values.
Verification requirement: rotation failure path is documented
